notes:
Summary: Lighthouse builds a SaaS customer support platform used by large retailers in EU. Primary goal: reduce live-agent volume by deflecting tickets with a RAG-powered bot.

Scale & indexing: corpus is ~5M tickets + product docs + KBs (~1.2B tokens). Want nightly + incremental ingestion (15m window) for new tickets. Estimate ~250M embeddings after metadata splits; expect ~3-6 shards for vector index.

Latency SLOs: retrieval <150ms median for vector search, rerank end-to-end for top-5 under 300ms target (strict for chat-first flows). POC targets: p95 retrieval <300ms, p95 rerank <500ms.

Quality targets: reranker must have top-5 precision >= 0.85 on internal testset (sampled deflection queries). Need to measure NDCG@5 and precision@5 during POC.

Cost sensitivity: target gross cost per query (full RAG roundtrip) < $0.01 for high-volume deflection flows; willing to compromise on cost for enterprise SLAs if predictable. Interested in Optimize's batching/caching recommendations and quantization profiles for 8-bit serving.

Integrations: Zendesk + Salesforce connectors needed; live ingestion pipeline must preserve attachments and metadata fields (customer-id, product-id, SLA-level). Single sign-on via SAML mandatory; IP allowlist for private control plane.

Security & compliance: EU data residency required for EU customers; SOC2 + ISO27001 in vendor profile required. KMS for key management (bring-your-own-key preferred). Audit logging and 12-month retention for query logs.

Stakeholders: Head of Platform (Eva Müller), CTO (Marko Petrovic), Support Ops lead (Sara O'Neill) - all participated in discovery. Quote from Support Ops: "We need deflection that feels like the top agent answer — not a random paragraph."

POC plan: 4-week POC. Week 1: index sample of 500k tickets and product docs; Week 2: run embed + vector baseline and latency tests; Week 3: plug in reranker (candidate generation -> cross-encoder) and collect NDCG; Week 4: soak test and SLA validation.

Open technical items: shard sizing recommendation (GPU vs CPU hybrid for reranker), fallback model variants for capacity spikes, eviction policy for hot-caching, encryption-at-rest verification for embedding stores.
